targetScopePolicy.historyTimePolicy: Every historical fact availableAt <= historyCutoffAt; current identity validFrom <= decisionAt; current map excluded.
targetScopePolicy.currentTimePolicy: One admitted source profile per coherent current frame; receipt <= decisionAt; no inferred event latency.
targetScopePolicy.betweenPolicy: Separate immutable team1/team2-oriented context; never reuse the previous map draft or sides as next-map inputs.

targetEligibilityPolicy.guard: Only current_identity/prior_maps definitions reach undrafted targets. Current draft/live/labels remain prohibited; BETWEEN uses a separately frozen team1/team2 history context.
